scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic for all primes; finite verification is supplementary and floating-point. Earlier phase-only results and the two-zero cardinality bound are credited, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three distinct parabola support points over prime fields p>=5, nonzero complex coefficients and exact two-zero constraints; no approximate-zero or higher-sparsity assertion. Independent mathematical or priority validation not performed.
title: Sharp coefficient-amplitude threshold for two Fourier zeros on a prime parabola
